explanation: Utah has zero tolerance for drivers under 21. Any measurable amount of alcohol can result in a citation and license suspension.

They have held the license for 30 days

Move over a lane if safe to do so, or slow down
Come to a complete stop on the freeway
Honk to warn the stopped vehicle
explanation: Utah's Move Over law requires drivers to change lanes away from a stopped emergency, tow, or maintenance vehicle with flashing lights when safe, or to slow down if changing lanes is not possible.

Use cruise control on the freeway

Yield to traffic already traveling in the roundabout
Enter quickly before other vehicles arrive
Always come to a complete stop before entering

Watch only the vehicle directly ahead
explanation: The three-second rule gives you time to react. Pick a fixed object the vehicle ahead passes, then count; if you reach it before three seconds, you are following too closely. Increase the gap in poor conditions.
